reason: I forget my vitamins on the counter, so a pre-counted evening sachet fixes a real problem for me. At $24.99 for the first box with a money-back guarantee, it is an easy yellow-cart impulse buy.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put several forms in one capsule? I am not sure bisglycinate alone is better, and $29.99 after the launch price feels a bit high for a brand I have never heard of.
would_change_my_mind: A creator video showing the sachet in a real evening routine, or a clear simple explanation of why bisglycinate alone is enough.
